properties.verseOrder: v1 v2 v3 v4 v5 v6

verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
TUSINZA nnyo erinnya lyo
Ayi Yesu Mukama,
Awamu n'abantu bonna;
Kababa waffe Yesu,afuga byonna.

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Mumwebaze, mmwe-abattibwa
Okubalanga ye
Musinze-eyabafiirira:
Kababa waffe Yesu,afuga byonna.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
Nammwe Bayisirayiri be
Abaanunulibwa,
Musinze-Omwana wa Dawudi
Kababa waffe Yesu,afuga byonna.

verse.name: v4
verse.lines:
Abantu abaasonyiyibwa
Olw'ekisa kye ye,
Mufukaamirire Yesu:
Kababa waffe Yesu,afuga byonna.

verse.name: v5
verse.lines:
Amawanga gonna-agensi
Muwulire Yesu:
Erinnya lye lisinzibwe.
Kababa waffe Yesu,afuga byonna.

verse.name: v6
verse.lines:
Twagala okutuukayo
Mu maaso ga Yesu,
Okumweyanza bulijjo:
Kababa waffe Yesu,afuga byonna.
